additional_info.subject: Need a deeper analysis – P&G Amiens (SID Y2/R5 313048135001)
additional_info.body:
Hello,
The client (P&G Amiens with eTrcuck NEOTRUCK) keeps insisting on highlighting charging failures. The explanations already provided are no longer sufficient; they now demand a proper analysis to clarify why we would face issues on the left side but not on the right. We therefore need to prepare a final report to get out of this deadlock.
This ticket should be handled by
Fosco, François, and Catalina
, as part of the ongoing analysis already initiated on this sensitive client (P&G Amiens – SID Y2/R5 313048135001).
We performed several tests with THOR 5 and THOR 3. Below are the detailed results:
Test 1 – THOR 5 at 13:12 and 13:18 – 18/09/2025
We connect the left charger → it does not work (see photo). We try disconnecting and reconnecting, but it still does not work.
We connect the right charger → it also does not work (see photo). We try disconnecting and reconnecting, but it still does not work either.
2. Test 2 – THOR 3 at 13:23 and 13:25 – 18/09/2025
We connect the left charger → it does not work.
We disconnect and reconnect the left charger → then it works.
We connect the right charger → it works immediately (no need to disconnect/reconnect).
3. Test 3 – THOR 5 (after performing a battery reset) at 13:34 and 13:36 – 18/09/2025
We connect the left charger → it does not work. After disconnecting and reconnecting, it then works.
We connect the right charger → it works immediately.
Conclusion from custemer P&G :
On THOR 3, both chargers operate correctly, although the left one requires being disconnected and reconnected on the first attempt.
On THOR 5, both chargers fail on the first attempt. After a battery reset, the left charger still requires disconnection/reconnection to work, while the right one works immediately.
We need a deeper analysis to clearly identify why and how these tests show different outcomes between the two connectors. Understanding the root cause of this asymmetry is crucial to provide P&G Amiens with a solid explanation and a corrective action plan.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob: +33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
